general.description:
H'Rkann is home to the K'Rinn and Ha'Tinkar species. Only the former survived their encounter, however, and that is a strain on the essentially pacifist K'Rinns.
H'Rkann is now the capitol world of the K'Rinn Council and as such, of 4/5 of K'Rinn space, the notable exception being the Ka'Ralt Secession.
general.bar: Wealthy and powerful K'Rinns playing holochess and spiraxy, and discussing with spacers and tradesbeings of all species
